description: This file defines the HomeBrowseFragment class, which is a fragment for Android TV that displays categorized rows including favorites, recent, continue watching, and categories. It uses Leanback library components to create a browsing UI with network-loaded images, and handles user interactions to navigate to workout and category details.

classes.name: HomeBrowseFragment
classes.description: A fragment that displays various categories and workout items in an Android TV app using Leanback components.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Initializes the fragment view, sets up the rows, and observes ViewModel state.

methods.name: showLoading
methods.description: Displays a loading indicator or placeholder.

methods.name: bindHome
methods.description: Binds data to UI by populating rows with workout and category items.

methods.name: addWorkoutListRow
methods.description: Creates a row for a list of WorkoutItems.

methods.name: addCategoryRow
methods.description: Creates a row for a list of CategoryItems.

methods.name: setupListeners
methods.description: Sets up item click listeners for workout and category items.

methods.name: openWorkout
methods.description: Navigates to the workout detail fragment.

methods.name: openCategory
methods.description: Navigates to the workout browse fragment filtered by category.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of HomeBrowseFragment.

classes.name: WorkoutCardPresenter
classes.description: A Presenter for displaying workout items as image cards on Android TV.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a view holder wrapping an ImageCardView.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds WorkoutItem data to the card view, loading images with Glide.

methods.name: onUnbindViewHolder
methods.description: Handles cleanup when view is recycled.

classes.name: CategoryCardPresenter
classes.description: A Presenter for displaying category items as image cards on Android TV.

methods.name: onCreateViewHolder
methods.description: Creates a view holder wrapping an ImageCardView.

methods.name: onBindViewHolder
methods.description: Binds CategoryItem data to the card view, loading images with Glide.
